notes: Cash-basis village. Governmental = General, Street, Library, Debt Retirement funds (p4 Total column); business-type = Water, Sewer, Sanitation (p6 Total column). Governmental cash is negative (Street fund (842,143)), apparently pooled cash with the utility funds; recorded as printed. 'Interest income' 943 and 'Bond payment - interest and fees' 3,230 are printed below Total Receipts/Disbursements under Other Financing Sources (Uses) and are recorded as outside_printed_total items; roll-forward -890,470 + 260,860 + 943 - 250,814 - 3,230 = -882,711. Small $1 rounding differences in the printed report are listed in report_discrepancies. Personnel services split by fund column (General 74,823 + Street 57,728 = 132,551). Operating expenses spans three funds and is not split because column amounts add to 72,026 vs 72,025 printed. Business-type receipts/disbursements are the single Total-column lines (Water 84,021/59,929, Sewer 16,622/4,298, Sanitation 54,621/56,290). Detail is the all-funds budgetary schedule (p8), the only supplementary schedule; its 'Charges for services' and Water/Sewer/Sanitation lines are business-type. Statement of net position (p1) Total column used for balance sheet.
